heading: On the snow. Off the clock.
intro: Ski days are at the heart of the weekend, with room to find your own pace. Participation and booking details are still being worked out.

items.title: Skiing at Yellowstone Club & Big Sky
items.description: We plan to ski a mix of Yellowstone Club and Big Sky Friday through Sunday. We may need to purchase passes for Big Sky; details will follow. Have an Ikon pass? Text Carter so we can plan accordingly.

items.title: Ski rentals
items.description: Compare four Big Sky shops and three Bozeman options in our rental guide, featuring Gallatin Alpine Sports. Plan for skiing February 19-21, and confirm pickup and return arrangements for your travel schedule. Rates in the guide are reference prices; confirm current pricing and availability with the shop.

items.title: Optional lessons
items.description: Interested in a ski lesson? Text Carter so we can gauge interest and coordinate plans. Browse the guide for adult lessons at Big Sky and Yellowstone Club, including YC Snowsports private lessons (ages 8+). Confirm arrangements before booking.

items.title: Backcountry excursion
items.description: A possible Saturday outing. Guide, conditions, ability requirements, equipment, cost, and booking arrangements are to be confirmed.

items.title: Curling
items.description: A Saturday activity in the working itinerary. Venue, time, equipment, and participation details are to be confirmed.

items.title: A slower kind of mountain day
items.description: No skis required. Shop, snowshoe, take in the summit views, or settle into a spa day. There are plenty of ways to enjoy the mountains and meet the skiers for lunch.

nonSkiers.heading: Mountain days, your way.
nonSkiers.intro: There is plenty to do beyond the ski slopes. Pick what sounds good and text Carter with your interests so we can coordinate outings and lunch together.
nonSkiers.note: These are options to explore, not scheduled group bookings. Text Carter to coordinate YC activities, equipment, classes, and spa appointments; confirm hours, availability, costs, and reservations before making plans.

items.title: Shopping in Big Sky & the YC Swag Store
items.description: Browse the shops in Big Sky or stop by the YC Swag Store for a little mountain souvenir.

items.title: Snowshoeing
items.description: Two pairs of snowshoes are available to share, with more available to rent. Ousel Falls and the track on Yellowstone Club property are options for a winter outing. Coordinate gear with Carter and choose a route based on current trail and weather conditions.

items.title: Cross-country skiing
items.description: Explore cross-country skiing on Yellowstone Club property or in Big Sky. Let Carter know if you are interested so we can coordinate equipment and trail plans.

items.title: Summit views at Kircliff
items.description: Ride the Explorer Gondola and Lone Peak Tram to the glass observation deck at the top of Lone Peak, with no skis required. A scenic outing could pair nicely with the day the group skis Big Sky. Check scenic tickets, operating conditions, and timing before booking.

items.title: YC Camphouse Gym
items.description: Keep your routine going with the gym machines or join a class at the Camphouse. Coordinate class availability and any booking details with Carter.

items.title: Ice skating at Camphouse
items.description: Trade skis for skates and spend some time on the ice at the Camphouse. Check session times and equipment arrangements with Carter.

items.title: Paddle tennis at Camphouse
items.description: Get a game together at the Camphouse. Let Carter know if you would like to play so we can coordinate court time and equipment.

items.title: A spa day
items.description: Unwind at the YC Spa, Spa Montage, or the spa at One&Only Moonlight Basin. Coordinate guest access, treatment availability, and reservations before booking.

items.title: Lunch with the skiers at Everett's 8800
items.description: Join the group for lunch on a Big Sky ski day. Everett's 8800 is a host favorite on Andesite Mountain, reached by Ramcharger 8 rather than the Kircliff gondola route. Reservations are required; confirm walking-guest lift arrangements with the restaurant when coordinating lunch.

items.title: Meet up at One&Only
items.description: Another idea for a Big Sky ski day: the skiers can head over to One&Only Moonlight Basin to meet non-skiers for lunch. Coordinate the restaurant, reservation, ski route, and non-skier transportation with Carter before heading over.
